text:
𝗗𝗔𝗬 𝟮 𝗔𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗗! 🏏🇮🇳

NZ resume at 246/5 in Christchurch. Blundell 53*, Phillips 36*.
Akash Deep removed Latham (59) and Rachin (9-ball duck); Mitchell fell for 31.

Can India bowl them out under 300? 👇
#INDvNZ #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗡𝗭 𝟮𝟰𝟲/𝟱, 𝗔𝗕 𝗗𝗔𝗬 𝟮! 🏏🇮🇳
👉 Christchurch Test mein Blundell 53* aur Phillips 36* ne unbroken 62 jod diye
👉 Akash Deep ne Latham (59) aur Rachin (9 ball ka duck) ko nipta diya
👉 Mitchell 31 par Jurel ke catch se out hue

Kya India NZ ko 300 se neeche rok payega?

#CricketKiBaat #INDvNZ #TeamIndia
